privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.p: ZYXEN is a software engineering studio based in Greece. We provide Umbraco platform engineering, Flutter applications, commerce systems, and AI integration services. Contact: hello@zyxen.gr

We collect information you voluntarily submit via our contact form: your name, email address, and project details. We do not collect sensitive personal data, financial information, or data from minors.

We use submitted information solely to: (a) respond to your project inquiry, (b) send a confirmation email, and (c) follow up regarding your project scope. We do not use your data for marketing without explicit consent.

Form submissions are processed via our secure systems. We retain inquiry data for up to 24 months after the last meaningful contact, after which it is permanently deleted. You may request deletion at any time.
We do not sell, trade, or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. Data may be processed by our email service providers under data processing agreements.
Under GDPR, you have the right to: access your data, correct inaccurate data, request deletion, restrict processing, and object to processing. To exercise these rights, contact: hello@zyxen.gr
We use cookies as described in our Cookie Policy. Non-essential cookies are only set with your consent. See our Cookie Policy for details.
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.
We may update this policy periodically. Material changes will be communicated via our website. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
For any privacy-related queries: hello@zyxen.gr | ZYXEN, Greece

cookies.title: Cookie Policy

sections.p: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help sites remember your preferences and understand how you use them.

Necessary: Essential for the site to function (session management, security). Analytics: Help us understand visitor behavior anonymously. Functional: Remember your language and preferences. Marketing: Used only with explicit consent for targeted content.
We may use analytics tools (e.g., privacy-first analytics) under their respective data processing agreements. No social media tracking pixels are active without consent.
When you first visit ZYXEN, a consent banner appears. You can accept all, reject non-essential, or manage individual categories. Your choice is stored locally and respected on all subsequent visits.

You can update your preferences at any time by clearing the "zyxen_cookie_consent" key from your browser localStorage, or via your browser settings. You can also disable cookies entirely in your browser, though this may affect site functionality.
Questions about our cookie use: hello@zyxen.gr
